targets.query: from(bucket: "trade_derived") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "TRADE_AGGRESSION") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["exchange_name"] == "${exchange}") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["symbol"] == "${symbol}") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["window_sec"] == "${window_sec}") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "buy_qty" or r["_field"] == "sell_qty" or r["_field"] == "total_qty" or r["_field"] == "net_flow") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> yield(name: "mean")
